subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the guard repairs and final-head validation, should OpenClaw accept these revised third-party actions in its privileged workflows?
rationale: Pin consistency and workflow syntax are deterministic, but accepting changed executable code at token, secret, publishing, security-upload, and agent boundaries requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve after validation
options.body: Repair the guards, rebase, pass focused checks, and accept the upstream-verified immutable revisions.

options.title: Split sensitive revisions
options.body: Remove any privileged action update that does not receive owner acceptance and land only the approved subset.

recommendation.title: Approve after validation
recommendation.body: Repair the guards, rebase, pass focused checks, and accept the upstream-verified immutable revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the changed security-sensitive workflow surfaces to this team.
